_readme: EXAMPLE VALUES ONLY. Copy to server/config/risk.json and set every number yourself — these are placeholders chosen to be valid and reasonable, not the numbers SCARF trades with. A wrong field falls back to the example default in src/config.ts (DEFAULT_RISK) and blocks new entries until fixed. Keep your real file off GitHub. The test suite uses this same file (test/fixtures/risk.example.json).
_initialCapitalUsd: Example value — set your own. Your starting capital in USD; the hard stop is counted from it.
_perActionShareByTier: Example values — set your own. Max share of the bucket per action, by source trust tier (follow = trust 10, fast = 7–9, full = 4–6).
_dailyLossStopShareOfDayStart: Example value — set your own. Daily stop: loss of the day (closed + open) as a share of the bucket at 00:00 UTC; new entries stop until 00:00 UTC.
_hardStopEquityShare: Example value — set your own. Equity below this share of initialCapitalUsd → full stop and a message to the owner.
_memecoinExit: Example values — set your own. Single exit rule for memecoins, used when memecoinClasses is absent.
_live: Example values — set your own. Live execution limits. Live trading stays off unless AGENT_MODE=live, AGENT_EXECUTION=live and AGENT_LIVE_CONFIRM=yes are all set.
_memecoinClasses: Example values — set your own. Exit profiles: call = source with trust ≥ callMinTrust; scan = bot cards, unknown authors, own picks. ladder: [price multiple, share of the whole position]; after the first sale the rest sits at break-even; checks: [minutes, multiple] — before any sale, price below the multiple → the core exits; floorPct — emergency floor; holdHours — max hold of the core; moonbag — a small tail counted from entry.
_memecoinEntry: Example values — set your own. Skip if the price already ran up ≥ maxRunUp1h× in the hour before the signal; buy only fresh pairs (< freshPairMaxMinutes) or old ones (≥ oldPairMinHours); stake ≤ shareOfCapital of the bucket. ageRuleExemptMinTrust: null = off.
_noPrice: Example values — set your own. A position with no price feed: sell after exitHours, write off after writeOffHours, retry every retryMinutes.
